note: Gates the game checks before it offers a quest: a relic weapon at some stage equipped or held, a collection of mounts owned, Eureka story and elemental level, Doman Enclave reconstruction progress, a deep-dungeon floor, a Resistance rank, Occult Record entries, a blue magic spell learned, a relic tool held. A gate Tsukimichi cannot read is listed as not checked, so the quest reads Not checked where it would otherwise read Ready (never Blocked by the gate itself). A gear gate lists its weapons under "equipped" (worn) or "held" (equipped, in the Armoury Chest or in the inventory): "items" are groups of Item row ids, any one group passing when every item of it is there (a paladin's sword and shield form one group), derived from the sheet rows in "sources" as the game-data tests check, with "shield" saying how a paladin's shield counts; it is judged from the gear the plugin captures, and reads not checked for a character captured without it. A mount-collection gate lists under "mounts" the Mount row ids that must all be owned ("all"), derived from the reward mount in "sources" (Mount#105: the mounts in the hundred of the Firebird's UIPriority with a ones digit) as the game-data tests check; it is judged from the owned mounts the plugin captures. An unlock-link gate lists under "unlockLinks" the unlock link ids that must all be set ("all"), derived from the sheet rows in "sources" (QuestAcceptAdditionCondition#row: the gated quest's own accept conditions that are no quest; Action#row: the UnlockLink a learned blue magic spell sets) as the game-data tests check; it is judged from the links the plugin captures. "metBy" names quests the game gives only once the gate is passed: one of them done meets the gate. "acceptConditions" are the sheet's accept conditions that are no quest which the gate stands for, listed under the gate rather than as an accept condition not checked. Every gate is confirmed by two sources: the game's text (gameTextKey, afterTextKey or requiredTextKey), the sheets (the derived lists), the wiki (the evidence page), the Lodestone ("lodestone": the quest's Eorzea Database page, whose requirement line states it) and Questionable ("questionable": true, for a quest docs/data/questionable-locks.json lists). A gate the wiki alone states may stand only when Tsukimichi never judges it (no weapons, mounts, unlock links, metBy, acceptConditions or after) and "playerConfirmed" says why: the player confirms it with I've done this. "requiredTextKey" is the text row of a quest the sheet already requires that says the gated quest waits for more. "after" names the quests before which the gate cannot be passed at all; the catalog adds them to the quest's prerequisites, with "afterTextKey" the text row of an after quest that says what it opens. "gameTextKey" is the gated quest's own text row stating the gate, when the game states one. The text is never committed. Keys are Quest sheet row ids, sorted ascending.

70941.gate: floor 50 of the Palace of the Dead cleared
70941.note: Pilgrimage of Light: the game offers it only once floor 50 of the Palace of the Dead has been cleared (its own text says so; the wiki infobox agrees). No flag a plugin can read outside the dungeon records the clear, so the gate is not checked; What Lies Beneath, the quasi-quest the game hands out after that clear, shows it passed. The House That Death Built opens the Palace of the Dead, so nothing passes the gate before it.
